label: the meals of the day
note: nashta ('breakfast') is taught in HI-C73-breakfast and the doing-word sense of khana in HI-C73-drink. HI-C79-dopahar-raat-ka-khana now names the other two meals as the transparent compounds they are -- dopahar ka khana and rat ka khana -- so all three meals of the day are nameable. Neither new name adds a word the track did not already own.
